Class LessonTestingAutomation

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.LessonTestingAutomation
public class LessonTestingAutomation extends Object

Title: LessonTestingAutomation Class.

Runs contributor CRUD, validation, list, subset, and restart tests through the real JavaFX controller and H2 database. Case numbers correspond to the requirements matrix in ContributorTests_Javadocs/RequirementsToTests.md.

Run twice in separate JVMs: the first execution writes a restart marker; the second verifies persistence and removes that marker. Set contributor.test.home to an isolated directory and optionally set contributor.test.evidence to save PNG snapshots. Exit status is zero only when every assertion in that execution passes. UI actions run on the JavaFX Application Thread; this is not a headless test.

Task 3 is checked through entity validation, persistent lesson CRUD, and collection operations. Task 4 is checked through the real MVC form, dialogs, buttons, and subset display. As in PasswordEvaluationTestingAutomation, each assertion reports its expected behavior and a pass/fail counter.
